description: The pie chart compares the proportions of two categories related to an unspecified variable or metric. The chart is divided into two slices. The larger slice, labeled "Reduction", is colored orange and accounts for approximately 69.92% of the total, while the smaller slice, labeled "Efficient deployment", is colored blue and represents around 30.08%. Both slices are labeled with their corresponding percentages and numerical values (60.9s and 26.2s, respectively). One slice is visually emphasized by being offset or "exploded" from the rest of the chart, specifically the "Efficient deployment" slice. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are displayed inside the slices. The two slices are arranged such that the larger slice is positioned at the bottom and the smaller slice is at the top.
